mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_post_repost (id, post_id, user_id, quote_content, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{postId}, #{userId}, #{quoteContent}, #{active}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quote_content = VALUES(quote_content), active = VALUES(active), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, user_id, quote_content, active, created_at, updated_at FROM community_post_repost WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, post_id, user_id, quote_content, active, created_at, updated_at FROM community_post_repost WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_repost WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND active = TRUE
SELECT post_id FROM community_post_repost WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND active = TRUE AND post_id IN #{id}
SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM community_post_repost WHERE active = TRUE AND post_id IN #{id} GROUP BY post_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_user_relation_control (id, actor_user_id, target_user_id, relation_type, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{actorUserId}, #{targetUserId}, #{relationType}, #{active}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active = VALUES(active), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, actor_user_id, target_user_id, relation_type, active, created_at, updated_at FROM community_user_relation_control WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_user_relation_control WHERE relation_type = 'BLOCK' AND active = TRUE AND ((actor_user_id = #{firstUserId} AND target_user_id = #{secondUserId}) OR (actor_user_id = #{secondUserId} AND target_user_id = #{firstUserId})))

SELECT target_user_id FROM community_user_relation_control WHERE actor_user_id = #{viewerId} AND active = TRUE AND relation_type IN ('MUTE', 'BLOCK') UNION SELECT actor_user_id FROM community_user_relation_control WHERE target_user_id = #{viewerId} AND active = TRUE AND relation_type = 'BLOCK'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_recommendation_feedback (id, user_id, post_id, feedback_type, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{postId}, #{feedbackType}, #{active}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active = VALUES(active), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, post_id, feedback_type, active, created_at, updated_at FROM community_recommendation_feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_id = #{postId} AND feedback_type = 'NOT_INTERESTED'
SELECT id, user_id, post_id, feedback_type, active, created_at, updated_at FROM community_recommendation_feedback WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT p.topic_id FROM community_post_like l JOIN community_post p ON p.id = l.post_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND p.topic_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.topic_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT pet_type FROM pet_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT p.id AS post_id, pet.pet_type AS value FROM community_post p JOIN pet_profile pet ON pet.id = p.pet_profile_id WHERE p.id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO processed_integration_event (event_id, consumer_name, processed_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{consumerName}, #{processedAt})
